name: HEIM
recent: Heineken Malaysia 在 2026 年 11 月公布截至 9 月底的季度业绩，营收与净利均下滑，主要受消费情绪疲弱与消费税影响。同期有分析机构调整对该股的评级，市场关注其盈利表现。
notable: 公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，营收为 RM539 million。
CGS 调整对该股的评级。
risks: 季度净利同比下滑，受消费税与消费情绪疲弱影响。
股价近期显著下跌，市场关注其盈利前景。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 RM434.75 million，环比下降 34.5%，同比下降 43.1%；净利为 RM50.53 million，环比下降 51.6%，同比下降 58.6%；净利率为 11.6%，低于上一季度的 15.7%。

recent_en: Heineken Malaysia released its quarterly results for the period ended September 2026 in November, with revenue and net profit declining due to weak consumer sentiment and excise duties. Analysts adjusted ratings on the stock during the period, with market focus on its earnings performance.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with revenue of RM539 million.
CGS adjusted its rating on the stock and noted an entry opportunity after the share price decline.
risks_en: Quarterly net profit declined year-on-year, affected by excise duties and weak consumer sentiment.
The share price has fallen significantly recently, with market attention on its earnings outlook.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM434.75 million, down 34.5% QoQ and 43.1% YoY; net profit was RM50.53 million, down 51.6% QoQ and 58.6% YoY; net margin was 11.6%, lower than 15.7% in the previous quarter.
